children: Overview
Belgium specialty chemicals and circular metals firm's H1 2026 revenue fell 22% on lower metal prices
H1 EBITDA declined 12%, demonstrating business resilience in less favourable market conditions
Company expects full-year 2026 EBITDA of about €65 mln if current conditions persist
Outlook
Campine expects full-year 2026 EBITDA of about €65 mln
Company sees potential for gradual recovery in antimony trioxide demand as prices stabilize
Campine expects synergies from Ecobat acquisition to increase progressively
Result Drivers
LOWER METAL PRICES - Revenue decline was mainly due to normalization of antimony and lead prices after exceptional 2025 peaks
ANTIMONY SUBSTITUTION - Reduced demand for antimony trioxide as customers substituted away from antimony-based flame retardants
PRODUCTIVITY IMPROVEMENTS - Higher throughput and productivity at French battery-breaking facilities offset lower smelting margins
